description: This file contains the 'ProjectDecorator' class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the HRM Time plugin. It provides methods to manipulate Project entities such as setting customers and project administrators.

classes.name: ProjectDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Project entity, providing methods to manage project associations such as customer assignment and project admin management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a specific Project instance.

methods.name: setCustomerById
methods.description: Associates a Customer to the Project using the customer's ID.

methods.name: setProjectAdminsByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Adds multiple Employee instances as project administrators based on their employee numbers.

methods.name: addProjectAdmin
methods.description: Adds a single Employee as a project administrator if not already present.

methods.name: removeProjectAdmins
methods.description: Removes all project administrators from the Project.
